Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 cluster hosted in CoreWeave (72-GPU NVLink domain intra-rack; NDR 400 Gb/s InfiniBand Fat-Tree inter-rack); total GPU count not stated
quotes: We trained the Granite 4.2 Language Models utilizing an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 cluster hosted in CoreWeave. Intra-rack communication occurs via the 72-GPU NVLink domain, and a non-blocking, full Fat-Tree NDR 400 Gb/s InfiniBand network provides inter-rack communication.
